name: shadowing-test-c0d314524b/shadowing-v.bal
spec_references: ## Module-level declarations: positive list includes Import declarations, Function definition, Constant declarations, Module variable declarations, Type definition and Class definition, but no XML namespace declarations.
## Statements: positive list includes Local variable declarations, If/else and Return, but no XML namespace declaration statements.
## Expressions: XML template expression — Supports interpolation in XML content and attributes; the expression list does not include typeof expressions.
reason: The case essentially asserts lexical shadowing of XML namespace bindings: module-level xmlns ns is replaced by function/block-local xmlns declarations, and three expected XML outputs verify the selected namespace URI. Namespace declarations and their scoping behavior are not covered by the subset's positive declaration/statement lists; support for XML templates alone does not establish this behavior. The case also contains typeof expressions, absent from the supported expression list.
unsupported_constructs: Module-level and local xmlns declarations and namespace-binding shadowing
typeof expressions in assertion failure paths
test_design_notes: The XML namespace behavior is executed and checked by explicit output assertions.
typeof occurs only in failure diagnostics; namespace shadowing alone suffices for the whole-case feature classification.
io:println is output instrumentation; value:toString is explicitly supported.
